security_audit.summary: All 97 static alerts are false positives caused by Markdown formatting, explicit resource links, or ordinary model fields. remediation.suggestion: Replace @latest with a reviewed exact version and document integrity verification before running registration, login, or MCP setup commands.

content.user_title: Train and Manage Neural Models with Flow Nexus
content.value_statement: Distributed neural training requires coordinated model, cluster, and monitoring operations. This skill guides Flow Nexus tools for training, inference, validation, and deployment.
actual_capabilities: Configures single-node training for feedforward, LSTM, GAN, autoencoder, and transformer architectures.
Runs predictions with trained models and reports inference metrics.
Lists, deploys, publishes, and rates Flow Nexus marketplace templates.
Initializes distributed clusters, deploys worker roles, and starts distributed or federated training.
Monitors training and cluster status, benchmarks performance, and creates model validation workflows.
Terminates distributed clusters when work is complete.
limitations: Requires Flow Nexus MCP tools and a Flow Nexus account for authenticated distributed training.
Depends on remote Flow Nexus and E2B services, so it cannot operate fully offline.
Examples use placeholder identifiers and datasets that users must replace.
Training costs, quotas, model quality, and data governance remain the user's responsibility.

use_cases.title: Prototype a Custom Model
use_cases.description: Configure a small neural architecture, start training, monitor progress, and benchmark results before scaling.

use_cases.title: Evaluate Marketplace Models
use_cases.description: Compare available templates, deploy a selected model, run predictions, and validate its performance.

use_cases.title: Operate Distributed Training
use_cases.description: Create a cluster, deploy worker roles, start federated training, monitor nodes, and terminate resources.

prompt_templates.title: Find a Template
prompt_templates.prompt: List free Flow Nexus neural templates for [task]. Compare architecture, accuracy, and tier, then recommend one without deploying it.

prompt_templates.title: Train a Single Model
prompt_templates.prompt: Design and start a [architecture] model for [task] using the [tier] tier. Use [epochs], [batch size], and [learning rate].

prompt_templates.title: Launch Distributed Training
prompt_templates.prompt: Initialize a distributed [architecture] cluster named [name] with [topology]. Deploy [count] workers, train on [dataset], and report every resource identifier.

prompt_templates.title: Run a Federated Lifecycle
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a federated workflow for [dataset] across [count] nodes. Include monitoring, benchmarking, validation, failure handling, and termination after approval.

output_examples.input: Find a free sentiment analysis template without deploying it.
output_examples.output: Recommended template: Sentiment Analysis Classifier. Category: NLP. Reported accuracy: 94 percent. Tier: free. No deployment started.

output_examples.input: Start a small feedforward classifier and summarize the training plan.
output_examples.output: Training started for a small feedforward classifier. Planned epochs: 100. Batch size: 32. Monitor the returned job identifier before deployment.

output_examples.input: Prepare a distributed transformer cluster, but wait before consuming resources.
output_examples.output: The mesh cluster plan includes one parameter server, worker nodes, and one aggregator. Deployment and training await confirmation.

best_practices: Start with nano or mini tiers, then scale only after validation and benchmarking.
Verify datasets, identifiers, resource tiers, and expected costs before each operation.
Monitor active jobs and terminate unused clusters to limit resource consumption.
anti_patterns: Do not train with sensitive data until governance, retention, and service policies are verified.
Do not deploy paid templates or large tiers without explicit user confirmation.
Do not publish models or submit ratings with placeholder identifiers or unverified results.

faq.question: What does this skill manage?
faq.answer: It guides Flow Nexus operations for neural training, inference, templates, distributed clusters, monitoring, benchmarking, validation, and publishing.

faq.question: Which neural architectures are supported?
faq.answer: The documented examples cover feedforward, LSTM, GAN, autoencoder, transformer, CNN, RNN, GNN, and hybrid configurations.

faq.question: Does distributed training require an account?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill states that distributed training requires Flow Nexus registration and authentication.

faq.question: Can it support federated learning?
faq.answer: Yes. It provides cluster and training examples with federated mode, aggregation rounds, and minimum participating nodes.

faq.question: Can it operate offline?
faq.answer: No. MCP setup, authentication, templates, remote sandboxes, and distributed training depend on Flow Nexus services.

faq.question: Does it guarantee model accuracy?
faq.answer: No. Accuracy depends on data, architecture, training settings, validation quality, and the behavior of external services.
